TAITO / WILLIAMS / 1981

DEFENDER

Insert a coin, then press 1 to start. For two players, insert two coins and press 2; players take turns.

C / 5 · Insert coin 1 / 2 · Start ↑ ↓ / W S · Up, down ← / A · Reverse → / D · Thrust SPACE · Fire SHIFT / B · Smart bomb Z / ENTER · Hyperspace P · Pause M · Sound V · Screen view F · Fullscreen H · Help

Rescue falling humanoids by catching them with your ship and setting them down on the ground. Smart bombs clear the screen; hyperspace is an emergency escape with a chance of destroying your ship. Drag the joystick vertically to fly. High scores are saved in this browser.

Original game © Williams Electronics, 1981. Embedded: game and sound ROMs assembled from mwenge/defender (Eugene Jarvis and Sam Dicker). Emulation: CPU cores adapted from iapx86 / JavaScript. Hardware reference: MAME williams driver.
